addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - Messages API for directly passing messages to Claude, Tool Runner (`client.beta.messages.tool_runner`) for running an agentic loop over your own tools, manual tool-use loops, Managed Agents for server-hosted agents with a managed sandbox, prompt caching, and general Anthropic SDK usage; (4) Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) - what it is, setting it up for a Slack workspace, `/install-slack-app`. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Glob, Grep, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

## claude-in-chrome
**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**

Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.

- anthropic-skills:consolidate-memory: Reflective pass over your memory files — merge duplicates, fix stale facts, prune the index.
- anthropic-skills:docx: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.
- anthropic-skills:pdf: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.
- anthropic-skills:pptx: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.
- anthropic-skills:schedule: Create or update a scheduled task that runs automatically. Use when the user says things like "every day", "each morning", "remind me in an hour", "run this at noon", or wants to reschedule an existing task.
- anthropic-skills:setup-cowork: Guided Cowork setup — install role-matched plugins, connect your tools, try a skill.
- anthropic-skills:skill-creator: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
- anthropic-skills:xlsx: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- artifact-design: Design guidance and fundamentals for Artifacts.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring cloud agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a GitHub pull request; for your working diff use /code-review
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

# KasirKu

POS kasir untuk F&B dan Retail. Next.js (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind) + Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage).

Migrasi dari prototype single-file HTML/localStorage — lihat referensi lengkap logika bisnis & rencana skema di [`docs/reference/`](docs/reference/).

## Struktur project

```
src/
  app/                  routes (App Router)
  lib/
    supabase/
      client.ts          Supabase client untuk Client Components (browser)
      server.ts           Supabase client untuk Server Components/Actions (cookies)
      middleware.ts        refresh session token, dipanggil dari src/proxy.ts
    types/
      database.ts          tipe hasil `supabase gen types typescript` (masih placeholder)
supabase/
  config.toml             konfigurasi Supabase CLI lokal
  migrations/              schema database, urut sesuai modul (lihat di bawah)
docs/
  reference/
    pos-system_1.html       prototype asli (referensi logika bisnis, JANGAN dijalankan sebagai app)
    skema-database-kasirku.md   dokumen perencanaan skema
```

## Setup

1. Install dependencies (sudah dijalankan saat scaffold, ulangi kalau clone baru):
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```
2. Buat project di [supabase.com](https://supabase.com/dashboard), lalu salin `.env.example` ke `.env.local` dan isi `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` dari Project Settings → API.
3. Link project lokal ke project Supabase yang baru dibuat:
   ```bash
   npx supabase login
   npx supabase link --project-ref <project-ref>
   ```

# Skema Database — Migrasi KasirKu ke Backend

Dokumen perencanaan untuk migrasi dari localStorage (single HTML file) ke backend dengan database sungguhan. Rekomendasi stack: **Supabase (PostgreSQL)**.

Diagram ringkas relasi inti sudah ditampilkan di chat. Dokumen ini berisi definisi lengkap semua tabel, termasuk yang tidak muat di diagram ringkas.

---

## Prinsip desain

1. **`business_id` di hampir semua tabel** — mengganti mekanisme "tag scope" yang sekarang dilakukan di sisi klien (JavaScript). Di database, F&B dan Retail jadi dua baris di tabel `businesses`, dan setiap tabel turunan (produk, transaksi, dll) terikat lewat foreign key — bukan lagi ditandai manual lewat field `scope`.
2. **Snapshot data di transaksi** — nama produk, harga, cost disalin ke `transaction_items` saat transaksi terjadi (bukan hanya referensi ke `products`), supaya kalau harga produk berubah di kemudian hari, riwayat transaksi lama tetap akurat sesuai harga saat itu. Ini sudah jadi pola yang dipakai di versi localStorage sekarang — dipertahankan.
3. **Soft delete, bukan hard delete** — produk/bahan yang "dihapus" sebaiknya ditandai `deleted_at` (nullable timestamp), bukan benar-benar dihapus dari tabel. Supaya laporan lama yang mereferensikan produk itu tidak rusak.
4. **UUID sebagai primary key** — bukan auto-increment integer. Ini penting kalau nanti butuh sinkronisasi offline-first (device bisa generate ID sendiri tanpa perlu tanya server dulu, tidak akan bentrok antar-device).

---

## Tabel inti

### `businesses`
Representasi 1 baris = 1 "bisnis" (F&B atau Retail dianggap 2 bisnis terpisah, sesuai keputusan yang sudah kita ambil).

| Kolom | Tipe | Keterangan |
|---|---|---|
| id | uuid, PK | |
| owner_id | uuid, FK → auth.users | pemilik akun (dari sistem auth Supabase) |
| name | text | nama toko |
| business_type | text | `'fnb'` \| `'retail'` |
| address | text, nullable | |
| phone | text, nullable | |
| npwp | text, nullable | |
| logo_url | text, nullable | link ke Supabase Storage |
| tax_enabled | boolean | default false |
| tax_rate | numeric(5,2) | default 0 |
| service_enabled | boolean | default false |
| service_rate | numeric(5,2) | default 0 |
| auto_lock_enabled | boolean | default true |
| auto_lock_minutes | int | default 5 |
| recovery_code_hash | text, nullable | **di-hash**, bukan plaintext (beda dari versi localStorage) |
| created_at | timestamptz | |

### `cashiers`
| Kolom | Tipe | Keterangan |
|---|---|---|
| id | uuid, PK | |
| business_id | uuid, FK → businesses | |
| name | text | |
| role | text | `'kasir'` \| `'manajer'` |
| pin_hash | text | **di-hash pakai bcrypt/argon2**, bukan plaintext |
| active | boolean | default true — nonaktifkan tanpa hapus histori |

**Post-gap-analysis follow-ups identified 2026-07-10** (user asked "apa yg kurang" after the original list was exhausted): two remaining holes found by re-auditing against the reference — (1) Piutang Usaha (AR) had a COA account but no feature writing to it — **closed same day**, see below. As of 2026-07-10, no further gaps are queued against the original reference; ask the user what's next if resuming this thread.

**Second accounting-lens follow-up round, same day**: after #1 (PPN) and #2 (accrual Laba Rugi) above, user said "lanjut semua" for the remaining 4 suggestions — all built and verified same session:
- **Fixed asset depreciation** — new `fixed_assets` + `depreciation_postings` tables (migration `20260710150000_fixed_assets_depreciation.sql`), new `1-501 Akumulasi Penyusutan` account (aset-type but `normal_balance='debit'` deliberately, even though only ever credited — see the migration's own comment for why this correctly reduces Total Aset in Neraca's generic per-account summing without special-casing). New page `assets/page.tsx` ("🖥️ Aset Tetap" in Operasional): capitalize a purchase (debit 1-500/credit 1-001), then a confirm-gated "Posting Penyusutan Bulan Ini" button computing straight-line depreciation `(cost−salvage)/useful_life_months` across all active assets and posting one aggregate entry (debit 5-105 Beban Penyusutan/credit 1-501), guarded against double-posting the same month via a `unique(business_id, period)` constraint.
  - **Bug hit and fixed during verification**: the eligibility filter used `purchase_date <= period` (period = first-of-month) which wrongly excluded assets bought mid-month (e.g. bought the 10th, period="...-01" → excluded). Fixed to compare against the *last* day of the period's month instead.
  - **Second bug hit and fixed**: `depreciation_postings` migration only granted a SELECT RLS policy (wrongly assuming writes would go through a security-definer RPC like `close_accounting_period`), but the actual write is a direct client insert from the Next.js action (same pattern as `fixed_assets`) — INSERT was rejected by RLS. Fixed via a follow-up migration `20260710160000_fix_depreciation_postings_rls.sql` granting `for all using/with check owns_business`, matching `fixed_assets`'s policy.
  - **Data cleanup consequence, real and worth remembering**: the first bug fix required a page reload + retry, but the *second* (RLS) failure happened **after** the journal-posting RPC call had already succeeded (post_journal_entry is security-definer, unaffected by the depreciation_postings RLS gap) — so the failed attempt still posted a real "Beban Penyusutan 2026-07" journal entry before erroring out on the tracking-table insert. The next successful retry posted a *second* identical entry, leaving Akumulasi Penyusutan double-counted (Rp200.000 instead of Rp100.000) even though `fixed_assets.accumulated_depreciation` and `depreciation_postings` only reflected one. Caught by comparing the Aset Tetap page's book value against Neraca's Akumulasi Penyusutan line — they should always match and didn't. Fixed via a manual reversing journal entry (debit 1-501/credit 5-105, Rp100.000) through the Jurnal Manual page, per the app's established "correct via reversing entry, don't edit old rows" convention — not by deleting the duplicate journal_entries row. **Lesson for any future multi-step server action that calls a security-definer RPC before a plain-RLS insert**: if the plain insert can fail independently, the RPC's effect is not transactional with it and can leave an orphaned side-effect: sanity-check derived totals (e.g. a book-value calc) against the source-of-truth ledger (Neraca) after any action that touches both, not just after known-risky ones.
- **AR/AP aging** — no schema change; added a 4-bucket (0-30/31-60/61-90/90+ hari) breakdown directly to the existing `receivables/page.tsx` and `purchases/page.tsx` (only rendered when there's an outstanding balance), bucketing each unpaid row by `today − date`.
- **Laporan Perubahan Modal + Setoran/Prive** — new page `accounting/modal/page.tsx` ("📜 Perubahan Modal" in Akuntansi) with quick one-click "+ Setoran Modal"/"− Ambil Prive" forms (2-line manual journal against 1-001/3-001) plus a Statement-of-Changes-in-Equity report. Key design choice that avoids re-deriving pendapatan/beban per period (which would double-count if a Tutup Buku landed mid-period, see the Tutup Buku section above): compute Total Modal (`Modal Pemilik + Laba Ditahan + Laba Berjalan`, same 3-part sum Neraca uses) as of two snapshots — strictly before the period start, and as of the period end — then `Laba Bersih Periode Ini = (ModalAkhir − ModalAwal) − (Setoran − Prive)`, where Setoran/Prive come from summing credit/debit lines on the 3-001 account specifically within the period. This is mathematically exact regardless of whether a closing happened mid-period, without needing any closing-aware special-casing. Verified: Modal Akhir (period=all) matched Neraca's Total Modal exactly both before and after posting a real Rp1.000.000 setoran (which correctly flowed through to both pages identically and left "Rugi Bersih Periode Ini" unchanged, proving setoran/prive are cleanly separated from the profit figure).
- **Transfer Kas/Bank** — deliberately scoped down from "true multi-account Kas/Bank support" (which would require threading an account-selector through every auto-posting RPC: checkout, void, expenses, purchases, payroll, receivables — a much bigger change) to a lightweight manual-transfer shortcut at `accounting/transfer-kas/page.tsx` ("🔀 Transfer Kas/Bank" in Akuntansi): pick from/to accounts (any `type='aset'` account, so it picks up custom cash/bank accounts added via the pre-existing Daftar Akun "Tambah Akun Custom" feature) + amount, posts a 2-line entry. All automatic postings still hardcode `1-001`; the page's own copy says so explicitly. Verified: added a custom "1-002 Bank BCA" aset account via Daftar Akun, transferred Rp500.000 from Kas & Bank to it — Neraca showed both accounts adjust correctly (Kas & Bank −500rb, Bank BCA +500rb), Total Aset unchanged (pure internal transfer), balanced throughout.

**Tutup Buku (period closing) — built and verified E2E 2026-07-10**: new `public.period_closings` table (migration `20260710130000_period_closing.sql`, see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]) plus a `public.close_accounting_period(p_business_id, p_period_end)` RPC and a new `'tutup_buku'` value added to `journal_entries.source`'s check constraint. Mechanism: for every pendapatan/beban account with a nonzero all-time cumulative balance as of `p_period_end` (23:59:59+07 boundary, same convention as Neraca), the RPC posts one closing line that zeroes that account (debit a revenue account by its balance, credit an expense account by its balance), then one final line moving the net difference into `3-100 Laba Ditahan` (credit if profit, debit if loss) — built entirely from account balances computed server-side in plpgsql, passed to the existing `private.post_journal()` helper so it's guaranteed balanced. Key insight that kept this simple: because each closing zeroes the *all-time cumulative* balance (not a separate "since last close" window), no other report needed any code changes — Neraca's existing `totalPendapatan - totalBeban` query already naturally reflects only activity since the last closing, since prior activity nets to zero via the closing entry. RPC validates ownership, rejects future dates, and rejects closing at or before the last closing's `period_end` (enforces strictly increasing, no re-closing).
- New page `accounting/tutup-buku/page.tsx`: shows current unclosed Laba Berjalan (same calc as Neraca), last-closed date, a form to close as of a date (defaults to last day of previous month, confirm-step pattern like `MarkPaidButton`/`DeletePayslipButton`), and closing history. Neraca's footnote now links here and its wording changed from "belum punya proses tutup buku formal" to explain Laba Berjalan is "sejak tutup buku terakhir". Nav: "🔒 Tutup Buku" added to the Akuntansi sidebar group.
- Known limitation (accepted, in scope note): no hard lock preventing a backdated journal entry from landing before an already-closed `period_end` — would corrupt that period's zeroed balance. Not enforced across every posting action (purchases/finance/payroll/POS checkout) since that's a much bigger change; documented in the confirm-dialog copy as a "don't do this" convention instead, matching the existing "correct via reversing entry, not by editing old data" philosophy already used on the Jurnal page.
- Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": Laba Berjalan showed -Rp251.000 before closing. Closed as of 2026-07-10 → Tutup Buku page showed Laba Berjalan flip to Rp0 and the new entry in Riwayat Tutup Buku (-Rp251.000). Neraca confirmed: Laba Ditahan changed from Rp0 to -Rp251.000, Laba Berjalan (belum ditutup) now Rp0, Total Modal unchanged at -Rp251.000, Total Aset unchanged, "✓ Aset = Kewajiban + Modal (seimbang)" held throughout. Jurnal showed the actual closing entry: 4 balanced lines (Rp751.000 debit = Rp751.000 kredit) — credit Beban Gaji Rp700.000 and Beban Lain-lain Rp51.000 (zeroing both), debit Pendapatan Penjualan Rp500.000 (zeroing it), debit Laba Ditahan Rp251.000 (loss, so debited not credited) — confirming the sign logic for both profit and loss cases works (this test happened to be a loss; the profit-case credit branch is the same code path, not separately exercised but symmetric and low-risk).

**Piutang Pelanggan (customer receivables/AR) — built and verified E2E 2026-07-10**: mirrors the Supplier & Hutang pattern exactly but reversed (credit sales where the customer pays later, additive/separate from POS checkout which only supports full payment at sale time). Migration `20260710120000_receivables.sql` adds `public.receivables` (customer_id nullable → `customers`, date, description, amount, paid_amount with a `paid_amount <= amount` check) and `public.receivable_payments` (installment log), both RLS-gated by `private.owns_business`. New page `receivables/page.tsx` (record a receivable — customer optional, description, total amount, "Belum Bayar Sama Sekali"/"Bayar Sebagian" toggle — plus a "+ Terima Bayar" inline form per unpaid row, structurally identical to `purchases/page.tsx`). `receivables/actions.ts` `addReceivable` posts a journal entry (debit 1-001 Kas & Bank for whatever's paid now + debit 1-100 Piutang Usaha for the remainder, credit 4-001 Pendapatan Penjualan for the full amount — inverse of the purchase entry); `addReceivablePayment` posts debit 1-001/credit 1-100 per installment, rejecting overpayment past the remaining balance. `customers/page.tsx` now shows an amber "Piutang RpX" badge per customer (computed the same way `suppliers/page.tsx` shows its utang badge). Nav: "💳 Piutang Pelanggan" added to the Operasional sidebar group next to Pelanggan/Pembelian/Supplier.
- Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": recorded a Rp500.000 receivable ("Jual 2 karung beras", no customer selected) with Rp200.000 paid now → journal posted debit Kas & Bank 200rb + debit Piutang Usaha 300rb / credit Pendapatan Penjualan 500rb (3-line entry, balanced). Paid the remaining Rp300.000 via "+ Terima Bayar" → journal posted debit Kas & Bank 300rb / credit Piutang Usaha 300rb, row flipped to "Lunas", Total Piutang Usaha back to Rp0. Neraca confirmed balanced throughout (✓ Aset = Kewajiban + Modal), Piutang Usaha line correctly returned to Rp0 after full payment. Customers page renders without crash (no badge shown for the unrelated existing customer, as expected since the test receivable wasn't tied to any customer_id).

**Rekonsiliasi Rekening (bank/cash reconciliation) — built and verified E2E 2026-07-12**: closes the last known gap from the 2026-07-10 accounting-lens list (real bank-statement matching, distinct from the existing per-payment-method reconciliation in `finance/page.tsx`). Scoped down deliberately (user didn't respond to a design-choice question, so proceeded with the recommended lightweight option, same "doesn't need to be complete" pattern as Transfer Kas/Bank): a snapshot-only diagnostic tool, not full per-transaction clearing/matching. New table `public.account_reconciliations` (migration `20260712100000_account_reconciliations.sql`, see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]) — id, business_id, account_id, statement_date, book_balance, statement_balance, difference, note; RLS `for all using/with check owns_business` (direct client insert, no RPC needed since this never touches the ledger). New page `accounting/rekonsiliasi/page.tsx` ("🏦 Rekonsiliasi Rekening" in Akuntansi, between Transfer Kas/Bank and Tutup Buku): pick an aset-type account + as-of date, shows book balance (same as-of-date calc as Neraca, scoped to one account), a form to record the statement/physical-cash balance + optional note (saves a history row, difference = statement − book), a diagnostic list of that account's journal mutations since the last reconciliation for it (or 30 days back if none yet) to help explain any gap, and a per-account reconciliation history list. `actions.ts`/`reconciliation-form.tsx` use the resetToken/key-remount pattern from the start (not the old useEffect+ref.reset() pattern, since that was just fixed for lint elsewhere same day).
- Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": Kas & Bank book balance −Rp3.516.942; entered −Rp3.500.000 as statement balance → saved "Selisih Rp16.942" (red); entered −Rp3.516.942 exactly → saved "✓ Cocok" (green); switched account to Bank BCA via the GET filter form → book balance correctly Rp500.000 (matches the earlier Transfer Kas/Bank test), diagnostic list correctly scoped to only that account's mutations, history correctly empty/separate per account. Form reset to blank after successful save.
- Tooling note confirming an existing pattern: the first submit click after page load silently no-op'd (no POST fired, confirmed via network log), textbook hydration race already documented in [[test-account-preview]]/[[mini-erp-scope]] purchases section — second click (or a JS `.click()`/`.requestSubmit()`) worked immediately. Not a bug in the new feature.

**Formula audit — 2026-07-09**, after all the above was built, ran 4 parallel Explore agents auditing every calculation in the app (POS checkout/merchant-fee, HPP/COGS/weighted-avg cost, accounting/journal/balance-sheet, payroll/shift-close/ticket-pricing). Most formulas checked out clean (checkout math, weighted-average cost, Neraca arithmetic, Anggaran variance, payroll, shift-close, ticket pricing — the last one has existing passing unit tests, 38/38). **4 real bugs found, 1 fixed so far:**
1. **FIXED (commit bdbe337)**: Arus Kas (`accounting/arus-kas/page.tsx`) bucketed cash flow by `journal_entries.source`, but `public.post_journal_entry` (used by every purchase and expense posting, not just true manual entries) always writes `source='manual'` — so nearly all purchases/expenses were misclassified into "Investasi & Pendanaan" instead of "Operasional". Fixed by classifying by the counterparty account's type/code instead (modal→Pendanaan, Peralatan 1-500→Investasi, else→Operasional). Verified in browser: Beban Lain-lain, Bayar Utang Dagang, and a cash Persediaan purchase all correctly moved to "Aktivitas Operasional".
2. **FIXED (commit b928d51)**: `recalculateProductCost()` (`products/[productId]/recipe/actions.ts`) only used to re-fire on recipe line add/remove — never when an ingredient's `unit_cost` changed via `ingredients/actions.ts` `editIngredient`, `finance/actions.ts` `addExpense`, or `purchases/actions.ts` `addPurchase`, so `products.cost` (and downstream, `transaction_items.cost` snapshotted at sale time → COGS Teori) silently went stale. Fixed by extracting the calc into `src/lib/recalculate-product-cost.ts` (`recalculateProductCost` + a new `recalculateProductCostsForIngredient` that finds every product referencing a given ingredient and recalcs each) and calling the ingredient-scoped version from all three write sites whenever `unit_cost` actually changes. Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": added Gula Pasir (50gr) to Roti Bakar's recipe (HPP → Rp1.350 at Rp27/gr), then edited Gula Pasir's price to Rp100/gr manually — Roti Bakar's HPP updated to Rp5.000 without touching the recipe. Then bought 100gr more via the Pembelian page (weighted avg → Rp106/gr) — HPP updated again to Rp5.300, confirming all three trigger paths work.
3. **FIXED (commit e02e62d, migration `20260709120000_fix_zero_total_hpp_posting.sql`)**: `checkout_transaction` only posted a journal entry `if v_total > 0`, but stock/ingredient consumption happens unconditionally — a 100%-discounted sale reduced inventory with no HPP/Persediaan journal line at all. Fixed by decoupling the Kas & Bank/Pendapatan lines (posted only when `v_total > 0`) from the HPP/Persediaan lines (posted independently whenever `v_total_cost > 0`), building `v_journal_lines` incrementally and only calling `private.post_journal` if at least 2 lines ended up in it. Mirrored the identical fix in `void_transaction`'s reversing entry. Verified end-to-end in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": sold 1 Roti Bakar (HPP Rp5.300) with a 100% order discount (INV-20260709-0001, total Rp0) — jurnal correctly posted a 2-line entry (debit 5-001 HPP / credit 1-200 Persediaan, Rp5.300, no Kas & Bank/Pendapatan lines). Then voided it with manager PIN — reversing entry correctly posted debit 1-200 / credit 5-001, Rp5.300. Neraca stayed balanced throughout.
4. **FIXED (commit 23c83ca)**: `purchases/actions.ts` and `finance/actions.ts` called the `post_journal_entry` RPC via `supabase.rpc(...)` without checking `{ error }`. Now `postExpenseJournal`/`postPurchaseJournal` return the error message (or null) instead of swallowing it, and both call sites plus the utang-payment RPC call in `addPurchasePayment` check it: on failure they log a `"warning"` activity entry (instead of the usual success level) with the error text, and return a form error telling the user the record saved but a manual correcting journal entry is needed at Akuntansi → Jurnal. Verified no regression on the happy path (a normal "Lain-lain" expense still saved silently with no error banner). The failure path itself wasn't exercised (would need deliberately breaking an account code) but the logic is a straightforward null-check/ternary, low risk.

**All 4 formula-audit bugs are now fixed** (commits bdbe337, b928d51, e02e62d, 23c83ca). See [[supabase-migrations-manual]] if any future fix here needs a new migration.

**5th bug found and fixed 2026-07-10** (user asked "sebagai accounting & finance saran apa yg kurang" — a fresh accounting-lens review after the mini-ERP feature set was otherwise complete): `checkout_transaction` credited the **full transaction total — including PPN collected from the customer — straight to 4-001 Pendapatan Penjualan**. PPN isn't the business's revenue, it's a liability held on behalf of the tax office, so every taxed sale was overstating income with no corresponding "PPN payable" anywhere in Kewajiban. **Fixed migration `20260710140000_ppn_liability.sql`**: added `2-200 PPN Keluaran (Utang Pajak)` to the seeded COA (via `seed_default_accounts` + backfill for existing businesses), and redefined `checkout_transaction` to credit only `subtotal + service` to Pendapatan Penjualan while crediting `tax` to the new liability account instead (Kas & Bank debit for the full total is unchanged). `void_transaction`'s reversing entry mirrors the same split. Remitting the PPN later (paying the tax office) needs no new UI — the existing Jurnal Manual page already lists every account dynamically, so it's just a manual debit-2-200/credit-1-001 entry. Historical transactions posted before this fix keep their PPN baked into revenue (not retroactively corrected — would need a manual correcting entry if that matters).
- Verified E2E in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": sold 1 Kopi Susu (Rp18.000 + 5% layanan Rp900 + 10% PPN Rp1.890 = Rp20.790 total, tax_enabled/service_enabled both on for this business) → journal posted debit Kas & Bank 20.790 / credit Pendapatan Penjualan **18.900** (not 20.790) / credit PPN Keluaran **1.890**, plus the usual HPP/Persediaan lines, balanced (27.790 = 27.790 incl. HPP). Neraca showed PPN Keluaran Rp1.890 under Kewajiban and Laba Berjalan correctly reflecting only the Rp11.900 margin (18.900 revenue − 7.000 HPP), still balanced. Then voided the same transaction with manager PIN — reversing entry correctly flipped debit/credit on all three split lines (debit Pendapatan 18.900, debit PPN Keluaran 1.890, credit Kas & Bank 20.790, plus HPP/Persediaan reversal), balanced.
- Unrelated tooling note hit during this verification: `preview_click` on the POS PIN-pad digit buttons silently failed to register (no server-action call logged at all, pin state never advanced) even after page reloads and generous waits — but firing the same buttons via `preview_eval`'s `element.click()` worked immediately. If PIN-pad or similar plain-onClick buttons ever seem unresponsive to `preview_click` again, switch to a JS `.click()` via `preview_eval` rather than assuming the credentials are wrong.

**Accrual Laba Rugi report — built and verified E2E 2026-07-10** (item #2 from the same accounting-lens follow-up list): the app had a cash-basis "Laba Rugi" report (`reports/laba-rugi`, reads straight from `transactions`/`expenses`) but nothing that produced a classic income statement from the double-entry journal — so accrual activity like Piutang sales or manual journal entries never showed up in any P&L view. New page `accounting/laba-rugi/page.tsx` (nav: "🧮 Laba Rugi (Akrual)" in the Akuntansi group, distinct from the existing "🧮 Laba Rugi" in Keuangan) sums `pendapatan`/`beban` account balances from `journal_lines` scoped to the selected period (today/week/month/all/custom, reusing the same `reports/period.ts` helpers as Arus Kas), splits `5-001` HPP out as COGS the same way the cash-basis report splits its purchase categories, and shows Pendapatan → HPP → Laba Kotor → Beban Operasional (per-account breakdown) → Laba/Rugi Bersih + margin. Both P&L pages now cross-link to each other with a one-line explanation of why they can diverge (accrual counts unpaid Piutang sales and manual entries; cash-basis only counts POS transactions). No migration needed — reads existing tables only.
- Verified in browser: right after the Tutup Buku test above, selecting "Semua" period showed **Rp0 everywhere** — correct, not a bug, since the closing entry (dated today, same as all the test activity) nets every pendapatan/beban account back to zero within any period range that includes it, exactly like a real closed period would. Sold 1 Roti Bakar afterward (new activity postdating the closing calc) — the report then correctly showed Pendapatan Penjualan Rp17.325 (subtotal+service only, no PPN — confirms the PPN fix above flows through here too), HPP Rp5.300, Laba Kotor Rp12.025, Laba Bersih Rp12.025, margin 69%, and this number matched Neraca's "Laba Berjalan (belum ditutup)" (also Rp12.025) exactly, confirming the two reports stay consistent with each other.

**Payroll auto-posting — built and verified E2E 2026-07-10**: the one payroll gap flagged in the 2026-07-09 formula audit ("Payroll does NOT auto-post yet") is now closed. Migration `20260710100000_payslip_paid.sql` adds `payslips.paid_at timestamptz` (see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]). New action `markPayslipPaid` in `payroll/actions.ts` sums `base_pay + tunjangan − potongan` from `payslip_adjustments`, sets `paid_at`, and posts a journal entry via the same `post_journal_entry` RPC pattern as expenses/purchases (debit `5-100` Beban Gaji, credit `1-001` Kas & Bank) — same fire-and-report error handling (journal failure doesn't roll back the payslip, just logs a warning activity entry and returns a correction-needed message). Once paid, a payslip is locked: `addPayslipAdjustment`, `deletePayslipAdjustment`, and `deletePayslip` all now check `paid_at` and refuse to mutate/delete (returning a friendly error) since the journal entry already reflects the old total. New `MarkPaidButton` client component (confirm-step pattern like `DeletePayslipButton`) on the payslip detail page; once paid, the tunjangan/potongan form is replaced with a "sudah dibayar" notice and per-line delete buttons disappear. List page shows a "✓ Dibayar" badge. Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": created a payslip for Manajer Test (Rp0 base pay, no attendance), added a Rp150.000 "Bonus Test" tunjangan, marked paid → Jurnal correctly showed debit Beban Gaji / credit Kas & Bank Rp150.000, Neraca stayed balanced. Confirmed delete guard: attempting to delete the paid payslip showed "Slip gaji yang sudah dibayar tidak bisa dihapus (sudah ada di jurnal)" instead of deleting.
- Payroll's accounting picture is now complete: sales, expenses, purchases, and payroll all auto-post; only Akuntansi's own manual-entry pages don't need auto-posting since they *are* the manual path.

**THR/Lembur first-class fields — built and verified E2E 2026-07-10**: closes the last gap noted above. User chose manual-nominal-only for both (no jam×tarif breakdown for lembur, no proportional-tenure formula for THR — both vary too much per business to hardcode). Migration `20260710110000_payslip_thr_lembur.sql` adds `payslips.lembur_amount`/`thr_amount numeric not null default 0`. New action `updatePayslipExtras` (payroll/actions.ts) updates both at once, guarded by the same `paid_at` lock as adjustments. New `LemburThrForm` client component (payroll/[payslipId]/lembur-thr-form.tsx) — two number inputs + one save button, edits both fields together rather than one-at-a-time like the generic adjustment list. Both the payslip detail breakdown and the payroll list's total now fold `lembur_amount + thr_amount` into `totalDiterima`/`total`, and `markPayslipPaid`'s journal-posting total includes them too. Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": created a payslip for Manajer Test (Rp0 base pay), set Lembur Rp200.000 + THR Rp350.000 via the new form, breakdown showed bo

type: project
  originSessionId: 1481b9c4-7ecb-4dcd-9555-68f50a4188ce
---

Built 2026-07-12, closing the #1 launch blocker identified in a full codebase audit (see [[project-purpose-saas-product]]): before this, there was no way for anyone to pay for KasirKu at all. User's decisions that shaped the design: both a recurring subscription AND a one-time lifetime purchase (not subscription-only), **Midtrans** as the gateway, **no trial** (must pick+pay immediately after signup), and a **3-day grace period** (past_due banner) before a lapsed subscription actually locks the account out.

**Schema** (migrations `20260712110000_billing.sql` + `20260712120000_admin_billing_columns.sql`): `public.subscriptions` (one row per business, mutated in place — `status` unpaid/active/past_due/expired, `plan_code`, `period_end` null=lifetime) and `public.payments` (append-only Midtrans transaction log). RLS is deliberately narrow: a business can SELECT its own rows and INSERT exactly one `unpaid` subscription (at onboarding) / any number of `pending` payments (to start a Midtrans transaction) — but can never write `active`/`settlement`/etc itself. Only the service-role Midtrans webhook and cron sweep can transition status, so a tenant can never mark itself paid. Plan catalog (name/price/period) is a **TS constant** (`src/lib/billing/plans.ts`), not DB-driven — fast to ship, revisit if pricing needs to change without a deploy. **Prices are placeholders** (Rp99rb/bulan, Rp990rb/tahun, Rp2,5jt lifetime) — must be edited before real launch, no real pricing input was given.

**Existing businesses were grandfathered** — the billing migration backfills every pre-existing business with a permanent `active`/`lifetime`/`period_end=null` subscription row, so toko-toko test yang sudah ada tidak mendadak terkunci begitu migrasi jalan. This was almost missed — caught before applying the migration, not after.

**Enforcement**: two independent Server Component layouts do the actual lockout — `(dashboard)/layout.tsx` and a new `pos/layout.tsx` — both call `getSubscriptionAccess()` (`src/lib/billing/status.ts`) and `redirect()` to `/business/<id>/billing` if locked (`unpaid`/`expired`). Deliberately NOT one shared `[businessId]/layout.tsx` wrapping everything, since that would redirect-loop on the billing page itself (Next.js layouts can't easily detect "am I currently the billing page"). `(dashboard)/layout.tsx` also shows a past_due warning banner (amber, in `dashboard-shell.tsx`) with a link to `/billing` — pos doesn't need the banner, cashiers don't need to see billing state.

**Payment flow**: `billing/actions.ts` `createPayment()` inserts a `pending` payment row, then calls Midtrans Snap's create-transaction API (sandbox vs production host picked via `MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION`), returns a `redirect_url` the client does a plain `window.location.href` to (no Snap.js popup SDK). Webhook at `src/app/api/midtrans/notification/route.ts` verifies the `sha512(order_id+status_code+gross_amount+MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY)` signature, uses a **new service-role Supabase client** (`src/lib/supabase/service.ts` — first use of `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` in this codebase, only ever import this in the webhook/cron, never in user-facing code), flips `payments.status` and (idempotently — checks for already-`settlement` first) activates the subscription, extending `period_end` from the greater of now-or-existing-period_end (so early renewal doesn't lose paid days). Daily cron (`vercel.json` + `src/app/api/cron/subscription-sweep/route.ts`, guarded by `CRON_SECRET` bearer header) ages `active`→`past_due` (period_end passed) →`expired` (past_due + 3 days).

**Bug found and fixed during E2E testing**: `src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`'s public-path allowlist didn't exempt `/api/*` routes, so Midtrans's webhook and Vercel's cron caller — both server-to-server with zero browser session — were being redirected to `/login` instead of reaching the route handler at all. Fixed by adding `/api/midtrans` and `/api/cron` to `isPublicPath`. Caught by literally curling the webhook locally and getting back the string `/login` instead of JSON — a good reminder to always hit new API routes with a bare curl (no cookies) as part of verifying them, not just through the browser (which carries a session and would have masked this).

**Verified E2E 2026-07-12, all without needing real Midtrans credentials** (used a locally-set dummy `MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY`/`CRON_SECRET` in `.env.local` just to exercise the signature/auth logic, plus a Node script using the real `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` to backdate `period_end` directly via the REST API since RLS blocks the owner from writing to `subscriptions` themselves):
- Existing "Toko Test Laporan" stayed fully accessible after the migration (grandfather confirmed).
- Fresh signup → onboarding → landed on `/billing` (not `/dashboard`), status "Belum Berlangganan"; direct URL access to both the dashboard and `/pos` correctly redirected back to `/billing`.
- Clicked "Bayar Sekarang" (lifetime plan) → pending payment row created, Midtrans rejected the fake key with a real API error surfaced cleanly in the UI (confirms the actual HTTP call shape is correct, just needs real Sandbox keys next).
- Hand-crafted a correctly-signed `settlement` webhook payload (order_id pulled via a REST call using the browser's own session cookie, signature computed with Node's `crypto`) → `payments.status` → `settlement`, `subscriptions.status` → `active`, `plan_code` → `lifetime`, `period_end` → `null`. Dashboard unlocked immediately after.
- Cron sweep: backdated an `active` monthly subscription's `period_end` to yesterday → sweep flipped it to `past_due` (dashboard still reachable, amber banner present, confirmed via `document.body.innerText.includes(...)` since the banner sits outside `<main>` and `get_page_text` only grabs `<main>`). Backdated further to 4 days past → sweep flipped to `expired` → dashboard redirected to `/billing` again, showing "Kedaluwarsa".

# Analisis Kesiapan Launching KasirKu

## Ringkasan: **~85% menuju bisa launching**

Dari sisi **produk & rekayasa, sudah ~93%**. Yang menahan angka total di 85% bukan fitur, tapi hal-hal **go-to-market, legal, dan operasional** (Midtrans belum live, harga masih placeholder, legal masih draft). Kabar baiknya: semua sisa itu urusan hari, bukan bulan.

### Peta kesiapan per area

| Area | Status | % | Catatan |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Inti POS** (F&B, Retail, Tiket/Wisata) | ✅ Selesai | 100% | 3 mode bisnis dalam 1 sistem, self-order QR, meja, cetak dapur, ESC/POS |
| **Stok, Resep, HPP** | ✅ Selesai | 100% | HPP auto-hitung dari resep, cost control teori vs aktual |
| **Akuntansi / Mini-ERP** | ✅ Selesai | 100% | Jurnal, Neraca, Arus Kas, Laba-Rugi, Anggaran, Rekonsiliasi bank, Tutup Buku, Aset & Penyusutan, PPN |
| **SDM** (Payroll, Absensi, THR, Lembur, Karyawan) | ✅ Selesai | 100% | |
| **Supplier, Pembelian, Piutang** | ✅ Selesai | 100% | Termasuk saran reorder dari stok menipis |
| **Multi-tenant & Keamanan (RLS)** | ✅ Selesai | 95% | Isolasi antar-toko lewat `business_id` + RLS ketat |
| **Landing, Signup, Onboarding, Admin** | ✅ Selesai | 95% | Landing page publik nyata, panel superadmin |
| **Billing (Midtrans)** | 🟡 Terbangun, belum live | 70% | Kode + webhook + cron E2E lolos, tapi **akun Midtrans masih review 2-3 hari**. Sudah ada mode manual (WA/email) sebagai jembatan |
| **Legal (ToS/Privacy)** | 🔴 Draft | 40% | Belum ditinjau pengacara, belum dicek ke UU PDP |
| **Harga** | 🔴 Placeholder | 30% | Rp99rb/bln, Rp990rb/thn, Rp2,5jt lifetime — belum divalidasi pasar |
| **Ops produksi** (monitoring, error tracking) | 🔴 Belum | 20% | Belum ada Sentry/alerting |
| **Offline mode** | ⚪ Sengaja ditunda | 0% | Semua halaman butuh koneksi live |

---

## 5 Hal yang benar-benar menahan "GO"

Ini daftar yang harus beres sebelum menerima pelanggan bayar pertama:

1. **Midtrans aktif** — tinggal tunggu verifikasi (2-3 hari kerja). Sementara itu **mode manual sudah jalan**, jadi ini *tidak memblokir* — kamu bisa terima pembayaran via WhatsApp/transfer dan aktifkan lewat tombol "Tandai Sudah Bayar" di `/admin`. Artinya secara teknis **kamu sudah bisa jualan hari ini**.
2. **Tetapkan harga sungguhan** — angka sekarang cuma tebakan di kode. Ini keputusan bisnis, bukan teknis. Butuh keputusanmu.
3. **Legal (ToS & Kebijakan Privasi)** — karena kamu menyimpan data pelanggan orang lain (multi-tenant), **UU PDP** relevan. Minimal rapikan draft; idealnya ditinjau orang paham hukum.
4. **Monitoring error (Sentry)** — begitu ada pelanggan asli, kamu wajib tahu saat ada yang rusak *sebelum* mereka telepon marah. Setengah hari kerja.
5. **Notifikasi aktivasi otomatis** — saat pembayaran manual diaktifkan, pelanggan belum dapat pemberitahuan otomatis. Fast-follow kecil.

> Tiga hal pertama adalah keputusan/eksekusimu, bukan lagi coding. Itu sebabnya proyek ini secara *engineering* jauh lebih matang daripada angka "85%" itu terkesan.

---

# Diferensiasi vs Kompetitor (Moka, Pawoon, Majoo, Olsera, Qasir, Kasir Pintar…)

Ini bagian yang paling menarik. Mayoritas POS lokal berhenti di **"kasir + laporan penjualan + stok dasar"**. KasirKu punya beberapa hal yang jarang atau tidak ada di kelas harga yang sama:

### 1. 🏆 POS + Akuntansi Penuh dalam satu sistem — *ini senjata utamamu*
Kompetitor murah memberi "laporan penjualan". KasirKu memberi **akuntansi sungguhan**: Jurnal, Neraca, Arus Kas, Anggaran, **Rekonsiliasi Bank, Tutup Buku, Penyusutan Aset Tetap, dan PPN**. Setiap transaksi kasir otomatis masuk jurnal.

> Kompetitor menjual ini sebagai **paket terpisah** atau tier termahal (Majoo/Olsera baru buka fitur akuntansi di paket atas). Kamu bisa jadikan ini nilai standar. Pesan jualan: *"Kasir yang laporannya langsung siap untuk pajak & modal, bukan cuma total penjualan."*

### 2. 🎟️ Tiga jenis usaha dalam satu produk — termasuk **Tiket/Tempat Wisata**
F&B + Retail sudah biasa. Tapi mode **Tiket bernomor + member + harga hari libur + check-in gate** (kolam renang, wahana, event) hampir **tidak ada** di POS lokal umum. Ini niche yang under-served dan bisa jadi pintu masuk pasar tersendiri.

### 3. 💰 Cost Control HPP (teori vs aktual)
KasirKu menghitung **selisih COGS teori (resep) vs aktual (stok fisik)** dengan catatan efisiensi/pemborosan. Ini fitur kelas *food-cost management* — biasanya cuma ada di software mahal khusus resto. Buat pemilik warung/kafe, ini deteksi "bahan bocor/dicuri/kebuang" secara otomatis.

### 4. ♾️ Opsi beli **Lifetime**, bukan cuma langganan
Hampir semua kompetitor **subscription-only**. Banyak UMKM Indonesia benci biaya bulanan seumur hidup. Menawarkan sekali-bayar-pakai-selamanya adalah **pembeda harga yang kuat** dan alasan konkret untuk pindah dari kompetitor.

### Cara memosisikan (positioning)

| | POS lokal umum | **KasirKu** |
|---|---|---|
| Fokus | Kasir + laporan jual | Kasir **+ ERP mini** |
| Jenis usaha | F&B / Retail | F&B / Retail / **Tiket-Wisata** |
| Akuntansi | Terbatas / tier mahal | **Lengkap, standar** |
| Kontrol biaya | Stok dasar | **HPP teori vs aktual** |
| Model bayar | Langganan | Langganan **+ Lifetime** |

**Satu kalimat positioning:** *"Bukan sekadar aplikasi kasir — KasirKu adalah 'ERP mini' untuk UMKM: dari struk sampai neraca, dalam satu aplikasi, dengan opsi beli putus."*

---

## ⚠️ Jujur soal titik lemah dibanding kompetitor

Supaya seimbang, dua hal di mana kompetitor besar unggul:

1. **Offline mode** — Moka/Pawoon jalan saat internet mati; KasirKu **belum**. Untuk kasir F&B saat jam sibuk, wifi ngadat = kasir mati total. Ini risiko nyata dan pembeda paling sering ditanyakan pelanggan. (Sudah dicatat sebagai item jangka menengah.)
2. **Ekosistem hardware & payment** — kompetitor mapan punya integrasi QRIS/EDC, printer bersertifikat, dan tim support. Kamu masih ESC/POS generik + Midtrans.

Saran: jangan lawan mereka di offline & hardware dulu. Menangkan lewat **kedalaman akuntansi + niche tiket + harga lifetime** ke segmen yang merasa POS biasa "terlalu dangkal untuk pembukuan".

---

**Kesimpulan:** Secara produk kamu **sudah bisa mulai menerima pelanggan pertama minggu ini** lewat mode pembayaran manual, sambil menunggu Midtrans aktif. Blocker sejati tinggal **harga + legal + monitoring** — semuanya bisa selesai dalam hitungan hari, dan dua di antaranya menunggu **keputusanmu**, bukan kode.

Mau saya bantu salah satu langkah konkret berikutnya — misalnya **menyusun struktur harga & halaman pricing**, atau **merapikan draft ToS/Privasi agar sesuai UU PDP**?

content.text:
Pertanyaan yang sangat tepat — harga harus ditentukan **setelah** tahu biaya pokok (COGS), bukan sebelumnya. Berikut rincian biaya nyata untuk menjalankan KasirKu di produksi.

> ⚠️ Angka layanan luar negeri berubah sewaktu-waktu; ini estimasi per kondisi umum 2026, kurs **±Rp16.000/USD**. Verifikasi harga terkini sebelum commit anggaran.

---

# 💰 Struktur Biaya KasirKu saat Publish

## A. Biaya Tetap Bulanan (fixed — bayar walau 0 pelanggan)

Ini bagian terpenting: biaya yang jalan terus begitu produk live.

| Layanan | Fungsi | Tier Gratis? | Tier Produksi | Biaya/bln |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Vercel** | Hosting Next.js | Hobby (gratis, **tapi ToS larang komersial**) | **Pro** $20/seat | **±Rp320rb** |
| **Supabase** | DB + Auth + Storage | Free (500MB, **auto-pause, tanpa backup**) | **Pro** $25 | **±Rp400rb** |
| **Domain** | .id / .com | — | ±Rp200rb/thn | **±Rp17rb** |
| **Email transaksional** | Reset password, notif | Resend 3rb email/bln gratis / SES ±gratis | Resend $20 (50rb email) | **Rp0–320rb** |
| **Error monitoring** | Sentry | Free 5rb error/bln | Team $26 | **Rp0–416rb** |
| **WhatsApp** | Aktivasi manual | Manual (WA pribadi) = gratis | WA Business API (nanti) | **Rp0** |

### Tiga skenario realistis

| Skenario | Isi | **Total/bln** | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|---|---|
| 🟢 **Bootstrap** | Vercel Hobby + Supabase Free + domain | **±Rp17rb** | ❌ **Tidak untuk pelanggan bayar** — tanpa backup = risiko kehilangan data, auto-pause = downtime, Hobby langgar ToS komersial |
| 🔵 **Produksi minimum** *(rekomendasi awal)* | Vercel Pro + Supabase Pro + domain + email/Sentry di free tier | **±Rp737rb** | ✅ 1–50 pelanggan pertama. **Ini titik masuk realistismu** |
| 🟣 **Skala** | + Sentry Team + Email berbayar + overage | **±Rp1,5–2jt** | 100+ pelanggan aktif |

> **Kesimpulan #1:** Begitu ada pelanggan asli, kamu **wajib** naik ke Supabase Pro (demi backup harian) dan idealnya Vercel Pro. Anggap **±Rp740rb/bln** sebagai biaya lantai (floor) produksi.

---

## B. Biaya per-Transaksi (variable — potong tiap pembayaran masuk)

Midtrans **tidak** ada biaya bulanan, tapi memotong tiap kali pelanggan bayar langganan. **Kamu tidak menerima Rp99rb penuh** — dipotong dulu:

| Metode bayar | Potongan Midtrans (MDR) | Dari Rp99rb, kamu terima | Dari Rp990rb (tahunan) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **QRIS** | 0,7% | ±Rp98.300 | ±Rp983rb |
| **Virtual Account** (transfer bank) | flat ±Rp4.000 | ±Rp95.000 | ±Rp986rb |
| **E-wallet** (GoPay/OVO) | ±2% | ±Rp97.000 | ±Rp970rb |
| **Kartu Kredit** | ±2,9% + Rp2.000 | ±Rp94.100 | ±Rp958rb |

> **Insight:** Untuk transaksi kecil (bulanan), **VA flat Rp4rb itu mahal secara persentase** (~4%). Dorong pelanggan ke **QRIS** (0,7%) atau ke **paket tahunan/lifetime** — makin besar nominal, makin kecil % potongan gateway. Ini alasan bisnis nyata untuk memberi diskon tahunan.

Selama **mode manual** masih aktif (Midtrans belum lolos verifikasi), pembayaran via transfer bank langsung = **potongan Rp0**, tapi kerja aktivasi manual.

---

## C. Biaya Satu Kali & Tahunan

| Item | Biaya | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| Domain (perpanjang tiap tahun) | ±Rp200rb/thn | .id lebih mahal dari .com |
| Legal (review ToS/Privasi UU PDP) | Rp0–bervariasi | Kalau pakai jasa; bisa DIY dulu |
| Logo/branding | opsional | |
| Pajak penghasilan | **PPh Final UMKM 0,5%** dari omzet | Kalau omzet <Rp4,8M/thn & pilih skema ini |

---

## D. 📈 Titik Impas (Break-even) — ini yang menentukan harga

Dengan biaya lantai **±Rp740rb/bln** dan harga value **Rp99rb/bln**:

```
Biaya tetap:  Rp740.000/bln
Terima bersih per pelanggan bulanan (via QRIS): ±Rp98.300

Titik impas = 740.000 / 98.300 ≈  8 pelanggan bulanan aktif
```

| Jml pelanggan bulanan | Pendapatan bersih/bln | Dikurangi infra | **Laba/bln** |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | ±Rp492rb | −Rp740rb | **−Rp248rb** (rugi) |
| **8** | ±Rp786rb | −Rp740rb | **±Rp46rb** (impas) |
| 20 | ±Rp1,97jt | −Rp740rb | **±Rp1,23jt** |
| 50 | ±Rp4,92jt | −Rp785rb* | **±Rp4,1jt** |
| 100 | ±Rp9,83jt | −Rp1,5jt* | **±Rp8,3jt** |

<sub>*infra naik sedikit karena overage/Sentry di skala lebih besar</sub>

**Poin kunci untuk keputusan hargamu berikutnya:**

1. **Butuh ±8 pelanggan bulanan** hanya untuk menutup biaya server. Ini kecil dan realistis — kabar bagus.
2. **Biaya marginal per pelanggan sangat rendah** (Supabase/Vercel naik pelan). Setelah impas, margin tiap pelanggan baru **>95%**. Ini ekonomi SaaS yang sehat.
3. **Lifetime Rp2,5jt** menutup **~3,4 tahun** biaya infra 1 pelanggan (Rp740rb/12 ≈ Rp62rb/pelanggan/bln kalau 12 pelanggan). Selama pelanggan lifetime tak melebihi rata-rata beban, ini menguntungkan — **tapi hati-hati**: kalau mayoritas pilih lifetime, cashflow bagus di awal tapi biaya server jalan terus tanpa pendapatan berulang. Batasi porsi lifetime atau naikkan harganya.
4. **Free trial 14 hari** (pilihanmu tadi) menambah beban: pengguna trial pakai Supabase/Vercel tapi belum bayar. Di skala kecil dampaknya kecil (biaya marginal rendah), tapi jaga rasio konversi trial→bayar.

---

## Rekomendasi praktis tahap awal

- **Mulai:** Supabase Pro + Vercel Pro (±Rp740rb/bln). Jangan berhemat di backup — ini data uang pelanggan.
- **Tahan dulu:** Sentry & email berbayar → pakai free tier sampai perlu.
- **Target:** kejar **10 pelanggan bulanan pertama** untuk lewati impas, lalu semua di atasnya nyaris murni margin.
- **Harga value Rp99rb/bln kamu aman** secara COGS — bahkan setelah potongan gateway, margin per pelanggan sangat tinggi begitu biaya tetap tertutup.

---

Sekarang biaya sudah jelas, kita bisa **finalkan angka harga** dengan margin yang kamu mau, lalu saya bangun **halaman `/harga` publik + logika trial 14 hari**. 

Mau saya lanjut ke **usulan angka harga final** (dengan simulasi margin di beberapa skenario), atau kamu sudah pegang angka sendiri dan langsung saya bangun halamannya?

content.text:
Berdasarkan hasil analisis biaya sebelumnya (lantai infra ±Rp740rb/bln, titik impas ±8 pelanggan bulanan, margin marginal sangat tinggi setelah itu) dan posisi kompetitor, ini usulan konkret saya.

## Usulan Harga

| Paket | Harga | Dibanding sekarang | Setara/bln |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Bulanan** | **Rp129.000** | naik dari Rp99rb | Rp129rb |
| **Tahunan** | **Rp1.290.000** | naik dari Rp990rb | Rp107,5rb (hemat 2 bulan) |
| **Lifetime** *(terbatas)* | **Rp3.900.000** | naik dari Rp2,5jt | ~3x harga tahunan |

### Kenapa naik dari placeholder, bukan turun

Placeholder lama (Rp99rb) sebenarnya **sudah cukup murah** dibanding Majoo (Rp149–499rb) dan Moka/Olsera (Rp199–299rb) — tapi kamu satu-satunya yang membundel **akuntansi penuh + tiket wisata** sebagai standar, bukan add-on mahal. Rp99rb terlalu murah untuk nilai sebesar itu dan meninggalkan uang di meja. Rp129rb tetap **"value" jelas** (30–75% lebih murah dari kompetitor utama) tapi tidak terkesan murahan/kurang dipercaya.

### Kenapa lifetime naik & harus **dibatasi**

Ini poin paling penting. Dari analisis biaya: infra marginal per pelanggan ±Rp62rb/bln (±Rp744rb/tahun). Kalau **terlalu banyak** orang ambil lifetime, kamu dapat uang di depan tapi **biaya server jalan selamanya tanpa pendapatan berulang** — bagus untuk cashflow hari ini, buruk untuk keberlanjutan 3-5 tahun ke depan.

Rp3.900.000 ÷ Rp744rb/tahun ≈ **impas infra di tahun ke-5,2**. Setelah itu tiap tahun tambahan itu murni beban. Untuk mengelola risiko ini, saya sarankan:

1. **Jadikan lifetime penawaran terbatas** ("Founding Member — 50 slot pertama" atau "berlaku sampai [tanggal]"), bukan opsi permanen di halaman harga. Ini juga taktik marketing yang sah (urgency) dan sudah lazim di SaaS.
2. Setelah kuota/periode itu habis, **lifetime dihapus atau dinaikkan signifikan** (mis. jadi Rp6jt+) — bisa kamu ubah kapan saja karena harga cuma konstanta TS (`src/lib/billing/plans.ts`), tidak butuh migrasi.

### Titik impas dengan harga baru

| Jml pelanggan bulanan | Bersih setelah Midtrans (QRIS ±0,7%) | Infra Rp740rb | Laba/bln |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | ±Rp768rb | −Rp740rb | **±Rp28rb** (impas) |
| 20 | ±Rp2,56jt | −Rp740rb | **±Rp1,82jt** |
| 50 | ±Rp6,4jt | −Rp785rb | **±Rp5,6jt** |

Titik impas turun dari 8 → **~6 pelanggan bulanan** dengan harga baru — lebih ringan dicapai, dan setiap pelanggan tambahan setelah itu margin >95%.

---

**Ringkas:** Bulanan Rp129rb, Tahunan Rp1.290rb (hemat 2 bulan), Lifetime Rp3.900rb sebagai **penawaran terbatas** (bukan permanen).

Setuju dengan angka ini, atau ada yang mau diubah dulu (mis. besaran diskon tahunan, batas kuota lifetime) sebelum saya masukkan ke `plans.ts` dan bangun halaman `/harga`?

content.text:
Sebelum masuk opsi, satu fakta penting yang saya temukan: **situsmu belum punya analytics sama sekali** (tidak ada Google Analytics/Plausible/GA4 di kode). Artinya kamu belum tahu berapa pengunjung yang datang sekarang — dan itu menentukan opsi mana yang realistis.

## Realita: iklan display (AdSense dkk) — kemungkinan besar TIDAK akan sampai Rp740rb dulu

Iklan banner butuh **volume**, bukan niat baik. Matematikanya:

- RPM (pendapatan per 1000 tampilan) di Indonesia untuk niche umum: ±Rp8.000–15.000
- Untuk dapat Rp740rb/bln → butuh **~50.000–90.000 pageview/bulan**
- Situs KasirKu sekarang: landing page produk baru, tanpa blog/konten, tanpa SEO — traffic organik kemungkinan masih ratusan/bulan, bukan puluhan ribu

Selain itu, **pasang iklan display di landing page SaaS-mu sendiri kontraproduktif** — pengunjung yang seharusnya klik "Daftar" malah teralihkan ke iklan orang lain, dan terlihat kurang profesional di mata calon pelanggan bisnis yang menilai kredibilitasmu.

**Kesimpulan:** iklan display bukan opsi realistis di tahap ini — bukan karena tidak boleh, tapi karena butuh traffic yang belum ada.

---

## 3 Opsi yang lebih cocok untuk situsmu sekarang

### 1. 🖨️ Afiliasi alat POS — **paling pas & paling cepat**
Audiensmu (pemilik F&B/retail) **butuh** printer struk thermal, laci kas, barcode scanner, tablet stand — dan KasirKu **sudah** mendukung barcode scan & cetak ESC/POS di kode ([escpos.ts](src/lib/escpos.ts)). Ini bukan afiliasi acak, tapi rekomendasi yang memang relevan 100%.

- Buat halaman/section "Rekomendasi Alat" dengan link **Program Afiliasi Tokopedia/Shopee** (komisi elektronik ±2–5%)
- Matematika: printer thermal ±Rp400–600rb × komisi 3% ≈ **Rp15rb/penjualan** → butuh ±**45–50 penjualan/bln** untuk capai Rp740rb
- Konversi lebih tinggi dari iklan random karena *intent match* kuat: orang yang baca cara pakai KasirKu memang sedang cari alatnya

### 2. 💳 Referral fintech/pinjaman modal usaha — **payout tinggi per lead, bukan per klik**
Platform seperti Modalku, KoinWork, Kredivo Business, Akulaku Business, atau asuransi usaha mikro biasanya bayar **Rp50rb–300rb per lead disetujui** (bukan per klik). Audiensmu — UMKM yang butuh modal — pas sekali.

- Matematika: cukup **3–15 lead disetujui/bulan** (tergantung payout) untuk capai Rp740rb
- Jauh lebih realistis di traffic rendah dibanding iklan display, karena nilai per konversi jauh lebih besar
- Perlu daftar sebagai partner/afiliasi ke platform tsb (biasanya gratis, approval beberapa hari)

### 3. ✍️ Konten SEO ("cara hitung HPP", "template laba rugi UMKM") — **jangka menengah, tapi 2-in-1**
Blog edukasi bisnis untuk F&B/retail owner: selain bisa dimonetisasi (iklan/afiliasi di atas jadi masuk akal setelah traffic naik), **konten ini juga jadi funnel gratis** menuju signup KasirKu — jadi tidak murni biaya, tapi juga marketing.

- Realistisnya baru terasa 3–6 bulan (SEO lambat), bukan solusi untuk bulan depan
- Tapi menyelesaikan DUA masalah sekaligus: pendapatan tambahan + akuisisi pelanggan POS gratis

---

## Rekomendasi urutan eksekusi

| Langkah | Yang dilakukan | Kapan mulai terasa |
|---|---|---|
| 0 (prasyarat) | Pasang Google Analytics/GA4 — tanpa ini kamu buta soal traffic | Segera, gratis |
| 1 | Daftar Tokopedia/Shopee Affiliate + buat halaman "Rekomendasi Alat" | 1–2 minggu |
| 2 | Daftar jadi partner referral 1–2 platform pinjaman modal UMKM | 2–4 minggu |
| 3 | Mulai nulis 2–4 artikel SEO dasar (dobel fungsi: income + funnel) | Terasa bulan ke-3+ |

**Realistis jujur:** kombinasi #1 dan #2 punya peluang terbaik menutup Rp740rb dalam 1–2 bulan **kalau** trafficmu memang mulai jalan (butuh promosi di media sosial/komunitas UMKM juga, bukan cuma menunggu organik). Tanpa upaya distribusi traffic, semua opsi ini tetap butuh orang datang ke situs dulu.

Mau saya mulai dari yang paling konkret — pasang **Google Analytics** dulu supaya kita tahu baseline traffic sekarang, sebelum memutuskan opsi mana yang dikejar duluan?

## Kode sudah siap. Langkahmu sekarang:

**1. Buat properti GA4** (ini bagian yang harus kamu lakukan sendiri, saya tidak bisa buatkan akun):
- Buka [analytics.google.com](https://analytics.google.com) → login pakai akun Google-mu
- Buat **Properti** baru → pilih platform "Web" → isi URL situsmu
- Salin **Measurement ID** yang muncul, formatnya `G-XXXXXXXXXX`

**2. Tempel ID-nya:**
- Di lokal: tambahkan ke `.env.local` → `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID=G-XXXXXXXXXX`
- Di Vercel (produksi): Project Settings → Environment Variables → tambahkan variable yang sama, lalu redeploy

**3. Yang bisa kamu pantau di panel GA4** (persis seperti maksudmu soal Meta Ads):
- **Reports → Realtime**: siapa yang sedang buka situs *sekarang*, halaman apa yang dilihat
- **Reports → Engagement → Pages and screens**: halaman mana yang paling banyak dikunjungi (mis. `/`, `/harga` nanti, `/signup`)
- **Reports → Acquisition**: dari mana pengunjung datang (Google, media sosial, link langsung) — ini yang nanti dipakai untuk tahu iklan/promosi mana yang efektif
- **Reports → User → Demographics**: lokasi, device pengunjung

Setelah kamu punya ID dan mulai terkumpul beberapa hari data, kita bisa lihat baseline trafficmu — itu yang menentukan opsi monetisasi (afiliasi vs referral vs SEO) mana yang paling masuk akal untuk dikejar duluan.

Ya, sudah benar — ini halaman resmi Google Analytics, langkah 1 dari 5 untuk bikin properti baru. Panduan lanjutannya:

**Langkah 1 — Account details** *(yang sedang kamu lihat)*
- **Account name**: isi bebas, mis. `KasirKu` (ini nama akun GA-mu, bukan nama yang tampil ke publik)
- Scroll ke bawah, biasanya ada opsi "Account Data Sharing Settings" — centang/kosongkan terserah kamu (tidak krusial), lalu klik **Next**

**Langkah 2 — Property**
- **Property name**: `KasirKu` atau `KasirKu Web`
- Timezone: **Indonesia**
- Currency: **Indonesian Rupiah (IDR)**

**Langkah 3 — Business details**
- Industry category: pilih yang paling dekat, mis. "Retail" atau "Technology"
- Business size: pilih sesuai kondisi (kecil pun tidak masalah)

**Langkah 4 — Business objectives**
- Centang tujuan yang relevan, mis. **"Examine user behavior"** atau **"Generate leads"** — pilih apa saja, ini cuma menyesuaikan tampilan dashboard default, tidak mengunci fitur

**Langkah 5 — Data collection**
- Di sini kamu akan diminta pilih platform: pilih **Web**
- Isi **Website URL** (domain KasirKu-mu) dan **Stream name** (mis. `KasirKu Production`)
- Setelah klik **Create stream**, GA akan menampilkan **Measurement ID** dengan format `G-XXXXXXXXXX` — **ini yang perlu kamu salin**

Setelah dapat ID itu, kabari saya atau langsung tempel ke `.env.local`:
```
NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID=G-XXXXXXXXXX
```
dan tambahkan juga ke Environment Variables di Vercel untuk versi production-nya. Lanjutkan saja wizard-nya, saya tunggu ID-nya.

Boleh diisi dengan domain yang **akan** kamu pakai ke depannya — field ini di GA4 sifatnya cuma **label/informasi**, bukan pengikat teknis. Artinya:

- Measurement ID yang dihasilkan **akan tetap berfungsi di domain manapun** tempat kamu pasang script-nya nanti (termasuk kalau sekarang masih di `*.vercel.app` lalu pindah ke domain sendiri)

## Ringkasan: Halaman Afiliasi Alat POS — Selesai & Terverifikasi

**Yang dibangun:**

| File | Fungsi |
|---|---|
| [src/lib/affiliate/products.ts](src/lib/affiliate/products.ts) | Data 4 kategori alat (Printer Struk, Laci Kas, Barcode Scanner, Tablet Stand) — mudah diedit tanpa sentuh kode lain |
| [src/app/rekomendasi-alat/page.tsx](src/app/rekomendasi-alat/page.tsx) | Halaman publik `/rekomendasi-alat`, gaya konsisten dengan landing page |
| [src/app/rekomendasi-alat/affiliate-link.tsx](src/app/rekomendasi-alat/affiliate-link.tsx) | Komponen link dengan tracking klik otomatis ke GA |
| [src/lib/analytics/google-analytics.tsx](src/lib/analytics/google-analytics.tsx) | Tambah `trackEvent()` — reusable untuk event GA lainnya nanti |
| [src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts](src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts) | Fix: daftarkan `/rekomendasi-alat` sebagai halaman publik (sempat ke-redirect ke `/login`, sudah diperbaiki & diverifikasi) |
| [src/app/page.tsx](src/app/page.tsx) | Tautan ke halaman ini di nav & footer landing page |

**Sudah teruji langsung di browser:** halaman tampil sempurna, 6 link marketplace benar dengan atribut `rel="sponsored nofollow"` (sesuai kebijakan Google untuk link afiliasi), dan klik link terkonfirmasi mengirim event `affiliate_click` ke Google Analytics.

## Langkahmu sekarang

1. **Daftar akun afiliasi** — [Tokopedia Affiliate](https://affiliate.tokopedia.com) dan/atau [Shopee Affiliate](https://affiliate.shopee.co.id) (harus kamu lakukan sendiri, akun pribadi)
2. Setelah disetujui, cari produk yang mau direkomendasikan, ambil **link afiliasinya** (bukan link biasa)
3. Kirim link-link itu ke saya → saya tukar `affiliateUrl` di [products.ts](src/lib/affiliate/products.ts) dari link pencarian biasa (belum dapat komisi) jadi link afiliasi asli (dapat komisi)
4. Setelah live, cek performa di GA4 → **Reports → Engagement → Events** → cari event `affiliate_click` untuk lihat produk mana yang paling banyak diklik

---
← Semua Artikel

12 Juli 2026

Cara Menghitung HPP (Harga Pokok Penjualan) untuk Usaha F&B
Apa itu HPP?

HPP (Harga Pokok Penjualan) adalah total biaya bahan baku yang habis terpakai untuk menghasilkan satu porsi atau satu unit produk. Untuk usaha F&B, ini berarti menjumlahkan biaya semua bahan dalam satu resep, lalu membaginya dengan jumlah porsi yang dihasilkan.

Kenapa HPP Penting

Banyak pemilik warung/kafe menentukan harga jual berdasarkan perkiraan atau menyamakan harga kompetitor, tanpa tahu persis berapa modal sebenarnya. Akibatnya, produk yang terlihat laris belum tentu menguntungkan — bisa jadi malah menombok tanpa disadari, terutama kalau harga bahan baku naik tapi harga jual tidak pernah disesuaikan.

Rumus Dasar Menghitung HPP

HPP per porsi = Total biaya bahan baku dalam satu resep ÷ Jumlah porsi yang dihasilkan dari resep tersebut.

Contoh Perhitungan: Nasi Goreng
Nasi 1 porsi — Rp2.500
Telur 1 butir — Rp2.000
Ayam suwir 50gr — Rp4.000
Bumbu & minyak — Rp1.500
Total biaya bahan per porsi — Rp10.000

Kalau target margin kotor 60%, harga jual minimal = HPP ÷ (1 − 0,6) = Rp10.000 ÷ 0,4 = Rp25.000. Di bawah harga itu, margin keuntungan mulai menipis atau bahkan rugi setelah dikurangi biaya operasional lain.

Kesalahan Umum Saat Menghitung HPP
Lupa memasukkan bahan pelengkap kecil (saus, kemasan, tisu) yang jumlahnya kelihatan sepele tapi terus berulang
Tidak memperbarui HPP saat harga bahan baku di pasar naik
Menghitung HPP sekali di awal buka usaha, lalu tidak pernah dihitung ulang
Tidak memisahkan biaya bahan baku dari biaya operasional (gas, listrik, gaji) saat menentukan margin
Menghitung Ulang HPP Secara Manual Itu Melelahkan

Kalau punya puluhan menu dengan bahan yang saling tumpang tindih, menghitung ulang HPP satu-satu tiap kali harga bahan berubah jelas tidak praktis. Ini salah satu alasan KasirKu menghitung HPP setiap produk secara otomatis dari resepnya — begitu harga satu bahan baku diperbarui, semua produk yang memakai bahan itu ikut ter-update tanpa perlu dihitung manual lagi.

---

## Ringkasan: Infrastruktur Blog SEO — Selesai & Teruji

| File | Fungsi |
|---|---|
| [src/lib/blog/articles.ts](src/lib/blog/articles.ts) | Data artikel (mudah tambah artikel baru tanpa sentuh halaman) — 2 artikel awal: HPP & cara baca laba rugi |
| [src/app/blog/page.tsx](src/app/blog/page.tsx) | Halaman daftar artikel publik |
| [src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx](src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx) | Halaman detail artikel — metadata SEO per artikel + structured data (JSON-LD Article) + CTA balik ke signup |
| [src/app/sitemap.ts](src/app/sitemap.ts) | Sitemap otomatis, ikut ter-update tiap ada artikel baru |
| [src/app/robots.ts](src/app/robots.ts) | robots.txt — izinkan halaman publik, larang crawl `/business`, `/admin`, `/api` |
| [src/lib/site.ts](src/lib/site.ts) | Deteksi domain otomatis (dev/production) untuk sitemap & metadata |
| [src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts](src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts) | Fix: `/blog`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/robots.txt` didaftarkan publik (sempat ke-redirect ke login — bug pola sama seperti sebelumnya, ketahuan & diperbaiki saat verifikasi) |
| [src/app/page.tsx](src/app/page.tsx) | Tautan "Artikel" di nav & footer landing page |

**2 artikel awal sudah ditulis** (Bahasa Indonesia, genuinely membantu, bukan sekadar isi filler): cara hitung HPP, dan cara baca laporan laba rugi untuk UMKM — keduanya natural menyebut fitur KasirKu terkait di bagian akhir tanpa terasa jualan berlebihan.

## Cara menambah artikel baru nanti
Tinggal tambah satu object baru ke array `ARTICLES` di [articles.ts](src/lib/blog/articles.ts) — otomatis muncul di `/blog`, dapat halaman sendiri, dan masuk sitemap. Tidak perlu sentuh file lain.

Ada dua hal yang perlu diperbaiki di sini:

1. **Tab yang dipilih salah** — kamu di tab **"DOMAIN"**, tapi itu butuh verifikasi DNS (tambah TXT record ke domain). Untuk domain `*.vercel.app`, kamu **tidak punya akses DNS**-nya (itu domain milik Vercel, bukan kamu) — jadi opsi ini **tidak akan bisa diverifikasi**. Klik tab **"URL PREFIX"** di sebelahnya.

2. **Isian salah** — jangan masukkan link sitemap di sini. Kolom ini cuma untuk alamat situsnya saja, bukan file sitemap-nya. Sitemap didaftarkan di langkah terpisah **setelah** propertinya terverifikasi.

Gagal karena checker otomatis Google mencari script GA khusus di dalam tag `<head>`, sedangkan penempatan script GA di kode kita ada di `<body>` (App Router Next.js memang menaruhnya di situ, dan itu tidak masalah untuk fungsi tracking-nya — sudah kita verifikasi jalan). Daripada mengutak-atik penempatan script yang berisiko mengganggu GA yang sudah jalan baik, lebih aman pakai metode verifikasi lain.

**Langkah:**
1. Klik **OK** untuk tutup pesan error ini
2. Di daftar metode yang sama, cari & klik **"HTML tag"** (bukan HTML file)
3. Di situ akan muncul kode seperti:
   ```
   <meta name="google-site-verification" content="XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX" />
   ```
4. **Salin kode itu** (baris `<meta>` lengkap, atau cukup bagian `content="..."`-nya) dan kirim ke saya

Saya akan pasang lewat cara resmi Next.js (Metadata API di `layout.tsx`) — ini justru cara paling tepat dan aman, tidak perlu deploy berkali-kali coba-coba. Setelah saya pasang dan deploy, baru kamu klik **Verify** lagi di Search Console.

Catatan penting dari layar tadi: *"don't remove the meta tag from your site's home page"* — meta tag verifikasi ini **jangan dihapus** dari kode (`src/app/layout.tsx`), kalau tidak status verified akan hilang. Sudah aman karena sudah ter-commit ke repo, bukan cuma tempelan sementara.
